headline: Zerodha founders buy 6.72% stake in Viceroy Hotels
hook: Kamath brothers acquire stake in Viceroy Hotels
summary: Zerodha founders Nithin and Nikhil Kamath have acquired a 6.72% stake in Viceroy Hotels. This investment follows the company's emergence from an insolvency-led crisis. The move marks a strategic entry into the hospitality sector for the Kamath brothers' investment portfolio.
why_it_matters: Signals potential turnaround interest in post-insolvency hospitality assets.

headline: Zerodha founders Nithin and Nikhil Kamath acquire 6.72% stake in Viceroy Hotels
hook: Kamath brothers bet on recovering hotelier
summary: Zerodha founders Nithin and Nikhil Kamath have acquired a 6.72 percent stake in Viceroy Hotels through their investment firms Kamath Associates and Nksquared. This investment coincides with the hotel company's recovery following an insolvency resolution process and its plans to raise Rs 105 crore via a rights issue. For Indian retail investors, high-profile promoter backing in a turnaround company signals potential restructuring value in the hospitality sector.
why_it_matters: High-profile backing signals potential turnaround value in hospitality
winners_losers: Viceroy Hotels gains / retail investors watch rights issue
